title: Understanding Non-response Bias
text: Non-response bias occurs when the individuals who do not respond to a survey differ in significant ways from those who do respond. This can lead to skewed results.

title: Consider the Sampling Method
text: Think about how the method of selecting every fifth student might affect the responses. Are there any groups of students who might be systematically excluded or less likely to respond?

hintAnswer: The sample may not represent the entire student population.
title: Identifying Potential Bias
text: What is a potential issue with asking only students who attend Data $$100$$ discussion sections?
choices: The sample may not represent the entire student population.

hintAnswer: They might have different schedules or preferences that affect their availability and choices.
title: Evaluating the Sampling Scheme
text: Why might students who attend Data $$100$$ discussions have different chocolate milk preferences than the general student population?
choices: They might have different schedules or preferences that affect their availability and choices.
They are more likely to drink chocolate milk.
They are less likely to drink chocolate milk.
